sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Wolverhampton Casuals in a fascinating clash between two teams at opposite ends of recent form. The visitors arrive as league leaders with an impressive 4 wins from their last 5, while Sandbach have struggled badly with just one win in their last five matches. This is a chance for Sandbach to make a real statement at home against the division's in-form side.
divisionWide: The title race looks extremely competitive at the top. AFC Bridgnorth travel to Alsager Town seeking to maintain their unbeaten record (3W, 1D), while Stafford Town—currently on a 3-match winning run—face Crewe at home in a fixture they should dominate. New Mills host Shawbury United in a direct battle between two teams level on points and separated only by goal difference, both pushing hard for a top-five finish. Eccleshall's inconsistent form (3W, 2L) is tested away at Foley Meir, who have won just twice in five games. Bilston Town host Barnton in a mid-table encounter with both sides needing to build momentum. Telford Town travel to face Brereton Social, with both teams fighting to climb away from the lower reaches. Market Drayton Town's poor form (1W from 4) continues as they visit struggling Dawley Town in what could be a defining encounter near the foot of the table. Finally, Wednesfield Community and Cheadle Heath Nomads meet in a basement battle where neither side has found consistency, and Allscott Heath's winless streak continues against Widnes Town at home.
